evidence: Lighthouse: Buttons do not have an accessible name
user_impact: Screen reader users may not understand the purpose of some buttons
recommended_fix: Provide a clear accessible name using visible text, aria-label, or an appropriate HTML label

evidence: Lighthouse: Image elements do not have alt attributes
user_impact: Screen reader users may miss information conveyed by images
recommended_fix: Add meaningful alt text to informative images; use empty alt for decorative images

evidence: Lighthouse: Form elements do not have associated labels
user_impact: Users of assistive technology may not know the purpose of form fields
recommended_fix: Associate every form control with a descriptive label

evidence: Lighthouse: Some elements have a tabindex value greater than 0
user_impact: Keyboard users may experience an unexpected focus order
recommended_fix: Remove positive tabindex values and use the natural DOM order

evidence: Lighthouse: Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order
user_impact: Screen reader users may find the page structure harder to understand
recommended_fix: Use a logical heading hierarchy without skipping heading levels unnecessarily
